# Windows Template Library 10.01

Source: https://git.code.sf.net/p/wtl/git

Pinned commit: `011be908a1122e7bc9fd1106ecc48f22f5f86f00`.

The complete Include directory and Notes/MS-PL.txt are copied without source changes. Include/atlapp.h defines `_WTL_VER` as `0x1001` (10.01). The application uses Visual Studio's ATL headers and these vendored WTL headers; MFC is not required.

AppWizard and sample code are not included or executed. See MS-PL.txt for the Microsoft Public License.
